description: NaLi₂Cl₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.66 Å) and two longer (2.71 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Li-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.67 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Cl-Li bond lengths are 2.64 Å. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cl-Na bond lengths are 2.66 Å.
